requirement.original: message.children is empty in the app even though sidechain messages ARE reaching the server
requirement.clarified: The toolFullViewRegistry in _all.tsx is missing Task and Agent entries, causing the detail view (ToolFullView) to render generic Description/Input/Output instead of TaskViewFull which displays children. The sidechain data pipeline works correctly -- children ARE populated on the Message object, but the detail view component never renders them.
requirement.what: Register Task and Agent in toolFullViewRegistry to map to TaskViewFull
requirement.why: Clicking Agent/Task tool calls shows only generic detail (Description, Input, Output) instead of the sidechain conversation with children
success_criteria: Task and Agent entries exist in toolFullViewRegistry mapping to TaskViewFull
Detail view renders expandable sub-tools section with children for Agent/Task tools
constraints: TaskViewFull is already imported and exported in _all.tsx

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Clicking Agent tool card opens detail view with only Description + Input Parameters + Output, no children conversation
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: toolFullViewRegistry in _all.tsx only contains MultiEdit entry. Task and Agent are missing, so ToolFullView.tsx line 110 getToolFullViewComponent returns null, and the SpecializedFullView conditional (line 119-121) renders nothing
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - entries were never added when TaskViewFull was created
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: TaskViewFull was created and registered in the regular toolViewRegistry (compact view) but the toolFullViewRegistry (detail view) was overlooked
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The detail/full view for Agent/Task tools shows only generic sections instead of the rich sidechain conversation

context.codebase_state: toolFullViewRegistry has only MultiEdit. TaskViewFull is imported (line 11) and exported (line 78) but not registered.

development_approach.strategy: Add Task and Agent entries to toolFullViewRegistry mapping to TaskViewFull
development_approach.validation_approach: Build check (yarn typecheck), then Playwright verification: navigate to dev.life-ai.app, find a session with Agent/Task tool calls, click the tool header, verify the detail view shows the expandable sub-tools section with children

research_findings.reason: Straightforward missing registry entry bug with clear root cause from code analysis

investigation_trace.step1_normalization: normalizeSessionEnvelope correctly sets parentUUID=envelope.subagent and isSidechain=true for sidechain messages. Session protocol tool-call-start creates content with id=envelope.ev.call. WORKS CORRECTLY.
investigation_trace.step2_tracer: getToolCallParentIds extracts both content.id and content.input.sessionSubagent. toolCallToMessageId maps CUID2 to message ID. Sidechain messages with parentUUID=CUID2 resolve via toolCallToMessageId. WORKS CORRECTLY (when in-order).
investigation_trace.step3_reducer_phase4: Sidechain messages stored in state.sidechains keyed by msg.sidechainId (= tool call NormalizedMessage.id). WORKS CORRECTLY.
investigation_trace.step4_children_population: convertReducerMessageToMessage reads state.sidechains.get(reducerMsg.realID) where realID matches the sidechain key. Children ARE populated. WORKS CORRECTLY.
investigation_trace.step5_sidebar_rendering: SidebarAgentConversation receives messages prop and renders children. But SidebarContentRenderer only handles the sidebar (mobile modal / desktop side panel). Desktop inline detail uses ToolFullView instead.
investigation_trace.step6_detail_view: ToolFullView uses getToolFullViewComponent (toolFullViewRegistry) which returns null for Task/Agent. The SpecializedFullView conditional renders nothing. THIS IS THE BUG.
investigation_trace.step7_registry: toolViewRegistry correctly maps Task->TaskView and Agent->TaskView. But toolFullViewRegistry only has MultiEdit->MultiEditViewFull. Task and Agent entries pointing to TaskViewFull are MISSING.
